rationale: Genome-wide CRISPRi (dPb2Cas12a) knockdown library of the 135 intergenic sRNAs of B. thetaiotaomicron (4 guides/arrays per sRNA, 20 non-targeting guides), Prezza et al. 2024. The input library was subcultured into rich medium (TYG) with IPTG, with (bile) or without (tyg) 0.05 mg/mL bile salts, in three biological replicates each, and grown to stationary phase. The paper's fitness screen compares guide abundance in bile vs no-bile (edgeR per guide, averaged per sRNA, Dataset S4), so the contrast is bile vs tyg. Knockdowns enriched under bile confer resistance; the named hit BatR (BTnc167) is enriched (increased numbers under bile) and BTnc353 is depleted. The library (glycerol-stock) samples are the input reference and are not part of the published comparison. Gene = sRNA (the mature and array guides of one sRNA are grouped, as the paper does); the 20 non_targeting guides form the control group. Three replicates per arm give the full BARCS model.
